title: vettd-cli scanner field gate manifest
description: Records the surface-or-gate decision for every field on the pinned vettd-skill-scanner SkillScanResult. Governed by vettd-cli#243 (epic #879). The gate script scripts/check-scanner-field-gate.sh fails a tag bump unless every new crate output field is classified here.
defaultLeaningNote: Optional, additively-shaped fields (per the epic convention: additive, optional, open strings, no closed enums, required unchanged, byte-identical when empty) are surfaced additively into scanner-data-contract.json when the bump author explicitly classifies them. Anything unclassified fails the bump.

findings.reason: Already surfaced: mapped into ExternalScannerResult.findings by contract/skill_scan.rs and present in scanner-data-contract.json.

has_skill_md.reason: Structural flag consumed internally for directory display (directory.rs); not part of the published scanner-data-contract.json surface.

has_scripts.reason: Structural flag consumed internally for directory display (directory.rs); not part of the published scanner-data-contract.json surface.

has_references.reason: Structural flag consumed internally; not part of the published scanner-data-contract.json surface.

has_evals.reason: Structural flag consumed internally for directory display (directory.rs); not part of the published scanner-data-contract.json surface.

file_count.reason: Internal metric consumed by directory display (directory.rs); not part of the published scanner-data-contract.json surface.

signals.reason: Non-finding signals emitted by the engine (e.g. declared license/capabilities). Surfaced additively into ExternalScannerResult.signals by contract/skill_scan.rs and present in scanner-data-contract.json v2.5.0.

coverage.reason: Scan coverage/attestation entries describing the analysis, not the asset. Surfaced additively into ExternalScannerResult.coverage by contract/skill_scan.rs and present in scanner-data-contract.json v2.5.0.

has_assets.reason: Structural flag (assets/ directory present); not part of the published scanner-data-contract.json surface.
